summary: This bill requires states to include in their highway-rail grade crossing safety reports how they will work with stakeholders to reduce pedestrian fatalities, including suicides, along railroad rights-of-way, and mandates these reports be submitted every five years.

scores.thoughts: This bill mandates continued periodic reports on highway-rail grade crossing safety and how states will work with stakeholders to reduce pedestrian fatalities. While these activities might incur some administrative costs, the bill itself does not appropriate funds or significantly alter existing spending levels, focusing instead on reporting requirements.
